name: movetrics-fdt-sdk
description: TypeScript reference client for the Movetrics FDT host link: Web Serial, Web Bluetooth (via the ESP32-S3 bridge) and Node.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of fs.readdirSync('dist')){if(!f.endsWith('.d.ts'))continue;const p='dist/'+f;fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace(/\.ts(?=')/g,'.js'));}"
